user.title: Tariff option
user.description: Choose the option of your EDF regulated tariff (TRVE) contract.

power.title: Subscribed power
power.description: Choose the subscribed power of your contract, among those currently offered for this option.

off_peak.title: Off-peak hours
off_peak.description: Enter the off-peak hours of your contract, as written on your bill, for example {example}. Separate several ranges with commas.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the contract
reconfigure.description: Change the option of your EDF regulated tariff (TRVE) contract. The next steps let you change the subscribed power and, for HP/HC, the off-peak hours.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot download the regulated tariffs grid. Try again later.
error.invalid_data: The downloaded regulated tariffs grid is invalid. Try again later.
error.off_peak_empty: Enter at least one off-peak range, for example 22:00-06:00.
error.off_peak_format: Each range must be written HH:MM-HH:MM, ranges separated by commas, for example 01:30-07:30,12:30-14:30.
error.off_peak_same_start_end: A range cannot start and end at the same time.
error.off_peak_overlap: The ranges overlap: each minute of the day can only be in one range.

abort.no_power_available: No subscribed power is currently offered for this option.

init.title: Off-peak hours
init.description: Enter the off-peak hours of your contract, as written on your bill, for example {example}. Separate several ranges with commas.

error.off_peak_empty: Enter at least one off-peak range, for example 22:00-06:00.
error.off_peak_format: Each range must be written HH:MM-HH:MM, ranges separated by commas, for example 01:30-07:30,12:30-14:30.
error.off_peak_same_start_end: A range cannot start and end at the same time.
error.off_peak_overlap: The ranges overlap: each minute of the day can only be in one range.

power_not_available.title: Subscribed power not found in the regulated tariffs
power_not_available.description: The regulated tariffs grid of the CRE has no tariff in force for {power} kVA, the subscribed power of "{title}": its prices are unavailable. If your contract changed, reconfigure the integration (Settings → Devices & services → Tarifs réglementés EDF (TRVE) → ⋮ → Reconfigure).
